method: Compile the Python example, execute its token-count functions against a fake SDK, and check the historical and provider-specific claim boundaries against current official documentation. No provider request was made.

observations.trace: The fixture confirms provider-reported count values are passed through and named baseline deltas are calculated; it does not reproduce the 2026-10-08 summaries. The retained split illustration has extra assistant text and cannot isolate message-boundary overhead.

limitations: Historical per-request inputs/responses, exact endpoint/model fingerprint, raw usage, case mapping and scorer are unavailable; 238/298 and 234/238/234/254 cannot be independently recomputed.
No live provider request, cache hit, billing behavior, answer quality, or production endpoint behavior was tested.
The fake SDK fixture validates only the local count wrapper and comparison helper; it does not establish real provider token counts or credentials behavior.
Token-count and prompt-cache behavior are provider/model/API-specific and may change; consult current official documentation.
